info.title: Enzo.Diagrams Agent API
info.description: Agent-ready contract for deterministic Enzo.Diagrams validation and rendering. Agents should generate only Enzo.Diagrams DSL, validate it, correct errors when validation fails, and render only valid DSL. Use hosted PNG delivery when an inline image URL is needed. Do not generate Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz, BPMN XML, raw SVG, or image bytes.

post.description: Parses and validates Enzo.Diagrams DSL without rendering. Use this before rendering non-trivial diagrams. If validation fails, correct the DSL and call validateDiagram again before rendering.

400.description: The request or DSL is invalid. Inspect the errors extension, correct the DSL, and validate again.

401.description: A valid API key is required.

post.description: Parses, validates, lays out, and renders Enzo.Diagrams DSL as SVG or PNG. Delivery defaults to raw bytes. Use format png with delivery url when an agent needs a short-lived hosted image URL that points to the actual generated diagram image and can be presented to the user. Call renderDiagram only after valid DSL has been produced.

200.description: Rendered SVG or PNG diagram, or hosted PNG result metadata when delivery is url.

hostedPng.description: The url points to the actual generated Enzo.Diagrams PNG and can be presented to the user until expiresAt.

400.description: The request or DSL is invalid.

401.description: A valid API key is required.

format.description: Render format. Prefer svg unless the user explicitly asks for png.

delivery.description: Result delivery mode. Omit or use raw to receive the rendered SVG/PNG response body. Use url with format png to receive hosted PNG metadata for inline image presentation.

format.description: Render format. Hosted URL delivery currently returns png.

contentType.description: Hosted image content type, normally image/png.

url.description: Short-lived read-only HTTPS URL for the actual Enzo-rendered PNG. Present this image URL directly to the user; do not redraw or regenerate the diagram.

expiresAt.description: UTC timestamp when the hosted image URL expires.

valid.description: True when the submitted DSL parses and validates successfully.

EnzoDiagramSource.description:
Enzo.Diagrams DSL source. Do not use Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz, BPMN XML, or raw SVG. Flowcharts start with flow <Name>. Supported flow declarations are start, task, decision, and end. Flow connections use Source -> Target, with optional labels as Source -> Target : label. Example: flow Example
start Begin "Start"
task Work "Process"
decision Valid "Valid?"
end Done "Done"
Begin -> Work
Work -> Valid
Valid -> Done : yes. The keyword node is invalid. Mermaid-style square-bracket node syntax must not be used. Sequence diagrams start with sequence <Name>. Declare actor and participant entries. Messages use Source -> Target: label, with --> allowed for response-style messages. Example: sequence Checkout
actor Customer "Customer"
participant Web "Web App"
participant Api "Order API"
Customer -> Web: Click checkout
Web -> Api: POST /orders
Api --> Web: 201 Created. BPMN diagrams start with bpmn <Name>. Supported BPMN declarations are start, task, gateway, and end. Sequence flows use Source -> Target, with optional labels as Source -> Target : label. Example: bpmn Fulfillment
start Received
task Validate "Validate order"
gateway Valid "Order valid?"
task Ship "Ship order"
end Completed
Received -> Validate
Validate -> Valid
Valid -> Ship : yes
Ship -> Completed.
